notes: Columns classified strictly from the CSV header (52, no invented columns).
post_race fields are shown in the picker but DISABLED with a leakage warning.
or and dist_f are object-typed (non-numeric tokens) -> coerce:true, treated as numeric.
dec, comment, wap_valid were not in the original explicit lists; classified post_race here (see each field's note).

fields.name: dist_f
fields.note: object-typed (non-numeric tokens); coerce to numeric.

fields.name: pos
fields.note: Finishing position - the outcome itself.

fields.name: ovr_btn
fields.note: Beaten distance (overall) - result-derived.

fields.name: btn
fields.note: Beaten distance - result-derived.

fields.name: time
fields.note: Race time - result-derived.

fields.name: secs
fields.note: Race time in seconds - result-derived.

fields.name: dec
fields.note: Industry SP (decimal) - settled at-the-off price; same class as bsp/wap.

fields.name: or
fields.note: Official rating; object-typed (non-numeric tokens); coerce to numeric. Leakage-safe pre-race rating.

fields.name: rpr
fields.note: Racing Post Rating - assigned post-race; leakage.

fields.name: comment
fields.note: In-running closeup describing how the horse actually ran - reads the result (despite run-style-proxy use in Stage-1).

fields.name: bsp
fields.note: Betfair Starting Price - settled price.

fields.name: pre_min
fields.note: Pre-off price aggregate - settled market data.

fields.name: pre_max
fields.note: Pre-off price aggregate - settled market data.

fields.name: ip_min
fields.note: In-play price - occurs during the race.

fields.name: ip_max
fields.note: In-play price - occurs during the race.

fields.name: pre_vol
fields.note: Pre-off matched volume - settled market data.

fields.name: ip_vol
fields.note: In-play matched volume - occurs during the race.

fields.name: wap
fields.note: Weighted average price - settled market data.

fields.name: morning_wap
fields.note: Morning WAP - market-derived; classified post_race for leakage-safety.

fields.name: morning_vol
fields.note: Morning matched volume - market-derived; classified post_race for leakage-safety.

fields.name: wap_valid
fields.note: Validity flag on post-race WAP pricing.

derived_features_leakage_note: prior-run only — must join to history STRICTLY before current race date; no same-race or future data.

derived_features.name: career_wins
derived_features.description: Count of the horse's prior runs finishing pos==1 (inferred from truncated spec; touches pos).
derived_features.leakage_note: prior-run only — must join to history STRICTLY before current race date; no same-race or future data.

derived_features.name: career_runs
derived_features.description: Count of the horse's prior runs in history.
derived_features.leakage_note: prior-run only — must join to history STRICTLY before current race date; no same-race or future data.

derived_features.description: Horse has previously won at this course (pos==1).
derived_features.leakage_note: prior-run only — must join to history STRICTLY before current race date; no same-race or future data.

derived_features.name: won_dist_flag

derived_features.leakage_note: prior-run only — must join to history STRICTLY before current race date; no same-race or future data.

derived_features.name: class_change

derived_features.leakage_note: prior-run only — must join to history STRICTLY before current race date; no same-race or future data.

derived_features.name: going_suit
derived_features.description: Horse's prior win/place rate on today's going.
derived_features.leakage_note: prior-run only — must join to history STRICTLY before current race date; no same-race or future data.

derived_features.name: sire_going_profile
derived_features.description: Sire's progeny win/place rate on today's going (prior runs).
derived_features.leakage_note: prior-run only — must join to history STRICTLY before current race date; no same-race or future data.

derived_features.name: sire_dist_profile

derived_features.leakage_note: prior-run only — must join to history STRICTLY before current race date; no same-race or future data.

derived_features.name: first_time_hg

derived_features.leakage_note: prior-run only — must join to history STRICTLY before current race date; no same-race or future data.

derived_features.name: run_style_proxy
derived_features.description: Run-style (e.g. led / prominent / held-up) parsed from PRIOR-run comments only.
derived_features.leakage_note: prior-run only — must join to history STRICTLY before current race date; no same-race or future data.
